1.original_instruction: The mage job quest NPC is located in Geffen in the northwest building ( geffen 63, 177).
1.short_ru: Войдите в северо-западное здание Geffen: geffen 63, 177.
1.short_en: Enter the northwest building in Geffen: geffen 63, 177.
1.full_ru: mage job quest NPC находится в Geffen, в северо-западном здании (geffen 63, 177).
1.full_en: The mage job quest NPC is located in Geffen in the northwest building ( geffen 63, 177).

2.original_instruction: Once inside, talk to the girl by the blackboard. She will tell you what solution number you need. The solution number you get determines what items you need and what you need to input in to the mixing machine. You can look up the ingredients you need at the book shelf located inside of the same room. Note: The catalyst item isn't needed, it is just a selection from the mixing machine list. [1] Milk can be obtained in Prontera at the Milk Merchant (76, 133) for 25z. [2] The Payon Solution is found in the Payon Archer Village (the Archer Village is accessible through the top right portal of Payon ). The NPC, named Dollshoi, is located at (118, 100). [3] The Morroc Solution is found in the Pyramids map located in the north west corner of Morroc . The NPC, named Ponka-Hontas can be found at (88, 147).
2.short_ru: У girl by the blackboard узнайте назначенный рецепт и соберите его материалы; катализатор — только выбор меню.
2.short_en: Ask the girl by the blackboard for your assigned recipe and gather its materials; the catalyst is only a menu choice.
2.full_ru: Внутри поговорите с girl by the blackboard. Она назовёт номер нужного раствора: от него зависят материалы и ввод в mixing machine. Рецепт можно посмотреть на book shelf в той же комнате. Катализатор не требуется как предмет: это только выбор в меню mixing machine. [1] Milk продаётся в Prontera у Milk Merchant (76, 133) за 25z. [2] Payon Solution можно получить в Payon Archer Village, куда ведёт верхний правый портал Payon, у Dollshoi (118, 100). [3] Morroc Solution можно получить на Pyramids map к северо-западу от Morroc у Ponka-Hontas (88, 147). Таблица рецептов: Solution # 1 — 2 Jellopy, 3 Fluff, 1 Milk; выбор Yellow Gemstone; Payon Solution; код 8472. Solution # 2 — 3 Jellopy, 1 Fluff, 1 Milk; выбор Red Gemstone; Town Solution не нужен; код 3735. Solution # 3 — 6 Jellopy, 1 Fluff; выбор Blue Gemstone; Payon Solution; код 2750. Solution # 4 — 2 Jellopy, 3 Fluff; выбор 1carat Diamond; Morroc Solution; код 5429. Ссылки таблицы: [1], [1], [2], [2], [3].

reviews.detail: Four assigned recipes and mixing codes are alternatives. Catalyst labels are exact machine options, never inventory fees. Table is restored separately without changing the archived instructions; town-solution counts are not printed.

The girl by the blackboard and returning main quest NPC are resolved within this guide; no personal name or Great Wizard identity is invented. Guild entrance is not an interior NPC point. Bare vendor/provider points retain display-name maps without inferred codes. Machine coordinates remain unknown.
